source_commit_provenance: Source revision confirmed by the validation orchestration; raw process.json records the invocation and process identity, but not git HEAD. Source file hashes are recovered from this immutable revision.
scope: Source-derived current-traversal scalar facts and actual native-emission metadata; serial focused tests, including original and decoded source programs
elapsed_scope: Build and serial test execution, not benchmark timing
coverage: Finite fact-analysis limits decline unsupported proof without assuming unknown facts
Control-flow joins discard one-arm facts and preserve only unchanged aliases
Enum partitions retain invalid remainder and boolean words remain opaque
Unsigned arithmetic uses exact current values and proven successful differences
Changed runtime input, source names and decoded programs preserve original results, every map update, error sites, and exact pre-publication compute/comparison spend and remaining fuel
Unproved arithmetic remains checked and fails at the original source site
Object metadata records actual omitted guards and emitted arithmetic with exact source sites/operands; disabling substitutions leaves explicit empty records while preserving packed SSA selection

previous_failure.distinction: The first run compared nondeterministic whole-publication work. The corrected test checks exact work at the boundary before independently seeded hash-map import/publication and retains exact end-to-end equality for empty/one-key results and source failures.
